messages:
oliver: kicking off canary v3.1.0 for embed-eu + gen-eu at 21:10 UTC. embed-eu variant -> modelx:quant-lite
deploy-bot: Canary progress 0% -> 100% in 9m. details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/6172024321 :robot_face:
jin: quick FYI  saw embed-kv-warmup p95 jump 100ms -> 340ms in eu-west1 at +4m
sre-oncall: runbook threshold: hold if synthetic p95 > 300ms for >2m AND kv-miss delta >10%
release-coordinator: what's the kv-miss delta on that spike?
jin: peaking +13% and prefill retries increased ~2x around the same window
oliver: prefer regional pinback to fp16 in eu-west1 instead of full rollback. lower blast radius
release-coordinator: acknowledged. rdctl command to run: `rdctl routes pin --route embed-eu --region eu-west1 --variant modelx:fp16 --reason "canary synth prefill spike"`
oliver: applying pin now...
deploy-bot: Route config patched; rollout id r-2026-10-01-6172. config version bumped.
smoke-bot: scheduled immediate rerun of embed-kv-warmup in eu-west1. ETA ~40s
smoke-bot: rerun results posted: pre-pin p95 345ms, kv-miss +13% -> post-pin p95 112ms, kv-miss +2% :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: holding global rollout paused for 15m observation per runbook. please add a short release note and open a tracker for warmup ordering
jin: release note added: "v3.1.0 canary: temporarily pinned embed-eu in eu-west1 to fp16 due to synthetic prefill latency spike during canary; investigation open (PERF-4207)." Link: https://tracker.redwood.internal/PERF-4207
release-coordinator: also enabling a temporary alert: kv-prefill-heatmap >10% during rollouts -> page ops-oncall for 30m while investigation runs
oliver: good call. will monitor heatmap and traces for 20m then close thread if stable. thanks all :thumbsup:
